assessments.reasoning: The last two sentences of the public IEC abstract expressly say ASN.1 defines abstract syntax of information and that other standards reference ASN.1 to define encoding rules for ASN.1 types.

challenge.method: Checked the paired statements against the ITU’s separate dated pages for X.680 basic notation and X.690 BER, CER, and DER.
challenge.results: Both the abstract and publication titles distinguish the notation from the document defining encoding rules. The cited text supports the descriptive boundary independently of any particular encoding behavior.

limitations: This is an abstract-level boundary. The separately published encoding rules and the clauses of X.680 have independent proof requirements.
